title: Reading Highlighter
tooltip: Reading Highlighter · Super+Shift+H: trail · hold Left Ctrl: capture
help: Turn the trail on with Super+Shift+H. Hold Left Ctrl, move through the words, then release Ctrl to save. No mouse button needed. Keep the page still and stay on one monitor. Super+Alt+H also works with the trail off.
ready: Ready to capture · OCR runs locally
capturing: Tracing… release the capture key to save
limitation: Adds editable text to your notes; does not mark the source document. OCR may make mistakes.
fileHelp: Choosing a folder applies immediately. For a typed path or filename, click Save settings. Folders use Reading Highlights.md; filenames without an extension get .md.
